run_GatherProto: run the GatherProto setuptools command to gather proto dependencies and copy them to the local proto directory
run_BuildPy: run the BuildPy custom build command to build package protos and compile the Python project
run_TestLite: run the TestLite command to execute gRPC tests without fetching or building any dependencies
run_RunInterop: run the RunInterop command to start an interop test client or server with optional asyncio support
run_RunFork: run the RunFork command to execute fork test client with pass-through arguments for testing
